sma.description: sma is the MySQL 8 database (sma_db, 34 tables) behind the 'Смарт Монгол туслах' (Smart Mongol assistant) app - users, cars, property sale/rent listings and offers, subscriptions/billing, AI assistant profiles and app logs; most of the app's KPIs are computed from it. People and cars are UUID tokens; the lake currently reflects a stale dump (newest registration 2025-12-08) until nightly loads start.

silver.sma_users.description: One row per registered sma app user (source table Users); answers total users (KPI 1), new users per period (KPI 4) and is the denominator for active-user share (KPI 2). Has no status/active column and no DAN-verification column, so 'active' and 'DAN-verified (ДАН-гаар баталгаажсан)' cannot be answered here.

columns.id: UUID token of the sma user (Users.id tokenised into the 'userId' namespace, so it matches userId in every other sma table - G18). Not the real user id.
columns.createdAt: Registration date of the user (real registration date per kpis.py KPI 4); truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.lastLogged: lastLogged timestamp of the user from the source Users table; passthrough - NOT truncated to the hour, unlike the other timestamps

silver.sma_useractionlogs.description: One row per user action logged in the app (source UserActionLogs); the activity source - 'active user' = has an action log in the period (KPI 2, KPI 3).

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.action: Action recorded in the log entry
columns.screen: App screen the action was logged on
columns.createdAt: Time the action was logged; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_smaerrors.description: One row per app error report (source SmaErrors); answers app error counts and affected users (KPI 46 'Апп алдааны мэдээллийн тоо') and error-free user share (KPI 3). The error text itself is dropped.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18) who hit the error
columns.createdAt: Time the error was recorded; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_cars.description: One row per car registered in the sma app (source Cars), loaded without plateNumber; with silver.sma_usercars answers registered cars, owners, average age and makes (KPI 26 'Нийт бүртгэгдсэн автомашин').

columns.id: UUID token of the car (Cars.id tokenised into the 'carId' namespace so it matches silver.sma_usercars.carId - G18). Not the real car id.
columns.markName: Car make (reference label; allowed under a CT015 waiver - a car's make is not a person's name)
columns.buildYear: Build year of the car (KPI 26 average age = current year - buildYear)
columns.importDate: Import date of the car; truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_usercars.description: Link table: one row per user-car pair (source UserCars, composite key userId+carId); joins users to cars for KPI 26.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.carId: UUID token of the car ('carId' namespace, joins silver.sma_cars.id - G18)
columns.createdAt: Time the user-car link was created; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_userlogs.description: One row per user log entry (source UserLogs, FK to Users).

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.action: Action recorded in the log entry
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_userapplogs.description: One row per user app log entry (source UserAppLogs, FK to Users); the app name column is not copied.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour (nullable in the source)

silver.sma_aiinfos.description: One row per AI assistant (AI туслах) profile of a user (source AiInfos); counts users with an AI assistant profile (KPI 32 - 'paid' not answerable, needs the priceInfo product mapping).

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.device: UUID token of the device (tokenised in its own 'device' namespace)
columns.robotLogo: Logo of the AI assistant ('robot') profile
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_notifyons.description: One row per user notification setting (source NotifyOns, FK to Users): which notification type/sub-type a user has enabled.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.enabled: Whether this notification setting is enabled
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_propertysalerents.description: One row per property sale or rent listing (source PropertySaleRents, FK to Users); answers rental/sale listings by town, type and stage (KPI 37 'Үл хөдлөх түрээсийн зарын тоо') - grouped by town, there is no 'complex grade' field.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18) who posted the listing
columns.propertyType: Property type of the listing (free varchar in the source, not an enum)
columns.townId: Town id (KPI 37 groups listings by it)
columns.stage: Listing stage (indexed with expiresAt as 'active' in the source)
columns.expiresAt: Listing expiry time; truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Time the listing was created (KPI 37 period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_propertysalerentoffers.description: One row per offer made by a user on a property sale/rent listing (source PropertySaleRentOffers).

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18) who made the offer
columns.approvedDate: Offer approval date; truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_propertysalerentofferhistorie.description: One row per history event of a property sale/rent offer (source PropertySaleRentOfferHistories, FK to PropertySaleRentOffers).

columns.propertySaleRentOfferId: Offer this history event belongs to (FK to PropertySaleRentOffers.id)
columns.createdAt: Time of the history event; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_propertysalerentimages.description: One row per image attached to a property sale/rent listing (source PropertySaleRentImages, FK to PropertySaleRents).

columns.propertySaleRentId: Listing the image belongs to (FK to PropertySaleRents.id)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_directoffers.description: One row per direct offer (source DirectOffers, FK to Users); the paid direct offers are the direct-offer part of rental brokerage commission income (KPI 38 'Түрээсийн зуучлалын шимтгэлийн орлого'), filtered on paidAt.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.towns: Towns of the offer (JSON in the source)
columns.price: Price (summed as direct-offer income in KPI 38)
columns.paidAt: Payment time (KPI 38 period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_auctionsubscriptionbills.description: One row per auction subscription bill for a sale/rent listing (source AuctionSubscriptionBills, FK to PropertySaleRents); paid bills are the auction part of rental brokerage commission income (KPI 38). Which status values mean 'paid' is unconfirmed.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.propertySaleRentId: Listing the bill is for (FK to PropertySaleRents.id)
columns.status: Bill status (the 'paid' values are not yet confirmed with the sma team)
columns.createdAt: Bill creation time (KPI 38 period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_subscriptionbills.description: One row per subscription bill (source SubscriptionBills). The product behind priceInfoId points outside the sma database, so 'which subscription product' (e.g. paid AI, KPI 32) cannot be answered yet.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.priceInfoId: Price/product id - points to a priceInfo lookup outside this database (no such table in the dump)
columns.priceInfoMethodId: Price-info method id (also outside this database)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_iotsubscriptions.description: One row per IoT (relay, релей) subscription of a user (source IotSubscriptions); answers activated relay subscriptions and their fee income by creation date (KPI 39). There is no payment-status column.

columns.userId: UUID token of the sma user (shared 'userId' token namespace, so it joins silver.sma_users.id - G18)
columns.priceInfoId: Price/product id - points outside this database
columns.startDate: Subscription start; truncated to the hour
columns.endDate: Subscription end; truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Subscription creation time (KPI 39 period filter); truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_dealactions.description: One row per action on a deal (source DealActions, FK to Deals, Agents and Users; Deals/Agents are not loaded).

columns.dealId: Deal the action belongs to (FK to Deals.id; Deals is not in the lake)
columns.agentId: UUID token of the agent (Agents table, not loaded; own 'agentId' token namespace)
columns.actorUserId: UUID token of the acting user (FK to Users.id in the source, but tokenised in its own 'actorUserId' namespace, so it does NOT match silver.sma_users.id tokens)
columns.at: Time of the action; truncated to the hour
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_statisticresults.description: One row per computed result of a statistic (source StatisticResults, FK to Statistics; Statistics is not loaded) - analytics domain.

columns.statisticId: Statistic this result belongs to (FK to Statistics.id; not in the lake)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

silver.sma_adminlogins.description: Source table AdminLogins (Users & identity domain); only id and timestamps are held - admin name and phone are never copied.

columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

bronze_ref.sma_iotsubscriptions.description: One row per IoT (relay, релей) subscription of a user (source IotSubscriptions); answers activated relay subscriptions and their fee income by creation date (KPI 39). There is no payment-status column. Stale duplicate left in bronze_ref by an earlier layer-routing change (claude.md 5i/5j); the control table now targets bronze, so use silver.sma_iotsubscriptions instead. userId here is the raw source Users.id (integer), not a token.

columns.priceInfoId: Price/product id - points outside this database
columns.createdAt: Subscription creation time (KPI 39 period filter)
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source
columns.userId: Raw source user id (Users.id), not tokenised

bronze_ref.sma_notifyons.description: One row per user notification setting (source NotifyOns, FK to Users): which notification type/sub-type a user has enabled. Stale duplicate left in bronze_ref by an earlier layer-routing change (claude.md 5i/5j); the control table now targets bronze, so use silver.sma_notifyons instead. userId here is the raw source Users.id (integer), not a token.

columns.enabled: Whether this notification setting is enabled
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source
columns.userId: Raw source user id (Users.id), not tokenised

bronze_ref.sma_subscriptionbills.description: One row per subscription bill (source SubscriptionBills). The product behind priceInfoId points outside the sma database, so 'which subscription product' (e.g. paid AI, KPI 32) cannot be answered yet. Stale duplicate left in bronze_ref by an earlier layer-routing change (claude.md 5i/5j); the control table now targets bronze, so use silver.sma_subscriptionbills instead. userId here is the raw source Users.id (integer), not a token.

columns.priceInfoId: Price/product id - points to a priceInfo lookup outside this database (no such table in the dump)
columns.priceInfoMethodId: Price-info method id (also outside this database)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source
columns.userId: Raw source user id (Users.id), not tokenised

bronze_ref.sma_adminlogins.description: Source table AdminLogins (Users & identity domain); only id and timestamps are held - admin name and phone are never copied. Reference-layer (bronze_ref) copy per the control table; timestamps are not banded here.

columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source

bronze_ref.sma_propertysalerentimages.description: One row per image attached to a property sale/rent listing (source PropertySaleRentImages, FK to PropertySaleRents). Reference-layer (bronze_ref) copy per the control table; timestamps are not banded here.

columns.propertySaleRentId: Listing the image belongs to (FK to PropertySaleRents.id)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source

bronze_ref.sma_propertysalerentofferhist.description: One row per history event of a property sale/rent offer (source PropertySaleRentOfferHistories, FK to PropertySaleRentOffers). Reference-layer (bronze_ref) copy per the control table; timestamps are not banded here.

columns.propertySaleRentOfferId: Offer this history event belongs to (FK to PropertySaleRentOffers.id)
columns.createdAt: Time of the history event
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source

bronze_ref.sma_statisticresults.description: One row per computed result of a statistic (source StatisticResults, FK to Statistics; Statistics is not loaded) - analytics domain. Reference-layer (bronze_ref) copy per the control table; timestamps are not banded here.

columns.statisticId: Statistic this result belongs to (FK to Statistics.id; not in the lake)
columns.createdAt: Row creation time in the source
columns.updatedAt: Row last-update time in the source
